summary: Set on Mars, the comic follows robotic explorers like Perseverance, Ingenuity, and Curiosity as they navigate and study the barren landscape. It contrasts active rovers powered by nuclear energy or having completed dozens of flights with silent, abandoned missions like InSight and Opportunity whose solar panels succumbed to storms. Ultimately, it paints a poignant, quiet picture of these enduring pieces of Earth keeping watch over a foreign world.
